title: Direct Proportion and the Unitary Method
summary: When one quantity doubles and the other doubles too: recipes, prices, speeds and unit conversions.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 11: Direct and Inverse Proportions

objectives: I can solve problems using the unitary method or a multiplier.
misconceptions: If one quantity goes up, they're always in direct proportion.
